current.text: He is out with a plantar fascia and toe issue in his foot. He is expected to miss at least four weeks and will miss the start of the season. Yahoo lists him as out (foot).
The experts no longer target him, even as a late-round flyer. One worries the foot injury could drag on, and another calls a pick around 103 way too early.
When he returns, he may be eased back on lower minutes.
He re-signed with Utah for 2 years and 22 million USD. Walker Kessler has left Utah.
Jaxson Hayes started at center in the preseason because Utah does not want Jaren Jackson Jr. to play much center. Kyle Filipowski is back in the rotation.
Before the injury, experts projected him as Utah's starting center when healthy, ahead of Ace Bailey and Kyle Filipowski. One projected him at 27 minutes.
He ranked about 68th last season, and he played at a top-70 level in his starts after Kessler got hurt.
If he starts at center once healthy, Josh expects at least top 80 numbers. His passing should matter more next to Jaren Jackson Jr. and Kyle Lowry, who do not pass much.
Utah is trying to win this season and is not expected to tank or shut players down. Its frontcourt is crowded, and minutes and usage are expected to be all over the place early.

durable.text: He has a history of knee, leg and other lower-body injuries.
Experts see him as hard to trust and not a reliable or healthy player.
He is a rebounding and passing center who can protect the rim. He is not a high-usage player.

FT% is his clear weak category. It hurts a team's FT% even on modest volume, which makes him a fit for punt FT% builds. Rebounds are his best category, and he gives good assists and steals for a center.

note: Nurkić is out at least four weeks with a foot injury. He is priced at 2 USD on Yahoo (rank 159) and 0 USD on ESPN (rank 170). That puts him outside the 144 players our league drafts, and the experts have dropped him as a target, so do not draft him. Once he returns, watch him on waivers. If he wins back the starting center job from Jaxson Hayes, his rebounds, assists and steals fit a punt FT% build, and experts saw top-80 upside in that role.
